headline: US-Iran tensions dent strong week for NZX50
summary: New Zealand's NZX 50 finished a strong week on a weaker note as prospects of a US military strike on Iran reduced appetite for risk. Gold, bonds and oil prices rose.
why: The NZX 50 is New Zealand's benchmark index of its largest listed companies. Geopolitical shocks often shift investors from equities toward gold, government bonds and oil.
